notes.title: "DLC 'Dimensional Crisis' Now Available"
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support and recommendations, dear players! The first DLC for "Liuyin: Divine Crossing", "Dimensional Crisis", has been released. Additionally, the base game is now available at a 15% discount, and a new DEMO will reopen by the end of this month.

New Map Quests

Players can explore the third floor of the "Midnight Palace" and interact with "Liuyin".

After the dialogue, you will receive the new quest "Dimensional Crisis".

Return to "Liuyin's Realm" to find a new quest NPC.

Enter the new map "Northern Cloud Marsh" through dialogue.

notes.title: Thank-You Letter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291820/61424f584e1b979c391cae71bbcb8e8c2dd48dc8.jpg[/img]
Thank you to all players who supported us by purchasing the game at launch! We acknowledge there were several issues during the first week of release, but we're actively collecting your feedback and will prioritize updates and maintenance. Below are some tips to enhance your gaming experience:

Gameplay Tips:

Defeat enemies encountered along your path whenever possible - this grants crucial resources for learning skills.

Prioritize learning various skills, especially those in the Nether King's Secret (冥王诀), as they significantly improve combat flexibility.

The game features multiple branching storylines where enemies may change. Since auto-saves are limited, we strongly recommend manually saving at save points frequently.

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291820/c900afc3a50a29618efddc73f2b297cfbd41ca51.jpg[/img]
At first, in order to enhance the visual experience of the battle, we made some bold attempts in the tuning of the camera. However, it was obvious that we played poorly, so we corrected the camera again, enhancing the openness of the field of view. At the same time, we greatly increased the priority of sprinting and dodging over martial arts, and suppressed the enemy to the end. This way, players can use sprinting or dodging to forcefully interrupt martial arts at any time and have more freedom in attack and defense transitions (but need to manage their physical strength to some extent). Thank you again for your valuable suggestions.

Optimize and adjust
1. Adjust the perspective to provide a broader perspective for battles.
2. Sprint to increase the distance response and make it attack enemies faster.
3. Prioritize teleportation evasion over martial arts, greatly enhancing the protagonist's mobility and improving combat fluency.
